description: This file implements the SourceDir class and related functions for handling directory paths, including validation, resolution, and string manipulation within a build system or project configuration context.

classes.name: SourceDir
classes.description: Represents a source directory path with methods for resolving relative paths and validation.

classes.name: SourceFile
classes.description: Represents a source file, used in resolving file paths.

methods.name: SourceDir::SourceDir
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a SourceDir object with a string view.

methods.name: SourceDir::ResolveRelativeAs
methods.description: Resolves a relative path as a file or directory, with validation.

methods.name: SourceDir::ResolveRelativeFile
methods.description: Resolves a relative file path based on the source directory.

methods.name: SourceDir::ResolveRelativeDir
methods.description: Resolves a relative directory path based on the source directory.

methods.name: SourceDir::Resolve
methods.description: Resolves the source directory path relative to a given source root.
